title: Painted peristyle of Thutmose IV
summary: Reconstructed painted pillars preserve part of a dismantled jubilee setting.
orientation: Partly reconstructed in the Open Air Museum, distinct from surviving in-situ pillars.

claims.text: Reconstructed painted pillars preserve part of a dismantled jubilee setting.
The pillars show the king embracing Amun; surviving pigments include red, yellow and blues.
Some pillars remained in situ while other remains were reassembled in the Open Air Museum. Present display and ancient setting differ.

caveats: Field access and demonstration viewpoints are unverified; this is an editorial research draft.
